This article compares the performance of Danish regions and hospitals on Indikator 3, which measures the proportion of newly diagnosed patients with atrial fibrillation who receive a TSH measurement between 60 days before and 30 days after their initial diagnosis date [^src1]. The established clinical standard for this indicator is ≥95% [^src1]. 

Across all regions and hospitals, the standard is universally missed; no entity achieved the 95% target [^src1]. At the national level, Denmark achieved a proportion of 77.4% in 2022/23 [^src1]. Among the five regions, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] performed best at 81.9%, followed by the Capital Region (Hovedstaden) at 81.1%, while [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] scored the lowest at 71.2% [^src1]. 

The highest-performing individual hospitals were [[regionshospitalet-horsens|Regionshospitalet Horsens]] (91.5%) and [[hospitalerne-i-nordsjaelland|Hospitalerne i Nordsjælland]] (91.1%) [^src1]. Other notable high performers included [[kolding-sygehus|Kolding Sygehus]] (89.7%) and Friklinikken Region Syddanmark Grindsted (87.5%), while [[vejle-sygehus|Vejle Sygehus]] scored 74.6% [^src1]. Conversely, the lowest-performing hospitals were Sygehus Sønderjylland (47.4%) and Næstved (47.6%) [^src1]. Næstved is a statistical outlier not only for its low score but also for its exceptionally small patient cohort (a denominator of just 21), which results in a very wide confidence interval (25.7-70.2%) [^src1]. Sygehus Sønderjylland also stands out as a major outlier, possessing a much larger denominator (898) but a proportion less than half the national average [^src1].

Although this comparison is drawn from a single dated table section, the table's internal columns reveal year-over-year trajectories from 2020/21 to 2022/23 [^src1]. Nationally, there has been a steady, albeit slow, improvement from 75.7% to 76.4%, and finally to 77.4% [^src1]. Some hospitals showed significant gains, such as Nykøbing Falster, which rose from 60.0% in 2020/21 to 73.9% in 2022/23 [^src1]. In contrast, other previously high-performing hospitals experienced declines, such as Herlev og Gentofte Hospital, which dropped from 84.2% to 81.5% over the same period [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner resultaterne for Indikator 3 på regions- og hospitalsniveau for perioden 2022/23 og tidligere år, og viser, at ingen region eller hospital opfylder standarden på ≥95 %, dog er Hospitalerne i Nordsjælland (91,1 %) og Regionshospitalet Horsens (91,5 %) de højeste.
